route.name: dependency-security
route.when: the failure is caused by a dependency problem that also involves a security vulnerability

route.name: security
route.when: a security vulnerability, CVE, credential, or cryptographic behaviour is involved

route.name: dependency
route.when: the failure is caused by an unresolved, missing, or conflicting dependency

route.name: test
route.when: one or more tests failed because of program behaviour

route.name: environment
route.when: the failure is caused by the environment, configuration, or a missing tool

route.name: success
route.when: the command completed successfully with no errors
